fin_stability.name: Financial Stability
fin_stability.note: ESCALATED 16:00 UTC: 30-year US Treasury at 5.34% (19-year high). Global bond sell-off deepening — all major sovereigns at decade+ highs. Japan 'running low on options' per Reuters. UK gilts 30Y at 5.7%. Gold $4,390 RED. Credit bubble terminal phase warning amplified.

energy.name: Energy Security
energy.note: ESCALATED 16:00 UTC: Trump declares Strait of Hormuz 'US territory' after 60-day Iran deal deadline expired. No diplomatic path visible. EIA forecasts oil prices remain elevated until global flows normalize. Hormuz effectively closed.

geopolitical.name: Geopolitical Conflict

currency.name: Currency Stability
currency.description: USD/JPY at 159.15 — AMBER threshold (158.0) breached. Intervention zone.
currency.note: ESCALATED 16:00 UTC: USD/JPY 159.65, weakening further. JGB 10Y near 3% (more than tripled in 2 years). Reuters: Japan 'running low on options' to fight bond rout. BOJ 8-1 vote to 1.0%, 80% probability of Sept hike. Terminal rate projected 1.75%. PM Takaichi fiscal plans hostage to bond market.

gold.name: Gold / Precious Metals
gold.note: Gold $4,390, pulled back slightly from $4,424 peak but remains deep in RED. Silver at $65.65. Safe haven demand persistent on Iran war + global bond sell-off + yen crisis. Central bank buying (China).

china.name: China Health
china.description: OECD Composite Leading Indicator for China (PMI proxy)
china.note: PBOC set USD/CNY midpoint at 6.7905 — less appetite for yuan rally. Digital yuan network expanded to 30 banks. July bank loans record contraction ongoing. Property crisis ongoing. Credit demand collapsing despite PBOC easing.

europe.name: Europe Stability
europe.description: ECB Deposit Rate (proxy for EU stability)
europe.note: ESCALATED 16:00 UTC: Global bond sell-off deepens. UK 10Y gilts ~5.05%, 30Y at 5.7%. German Bund 3.26% (highest since 2011). Markets swung from pricing cuts to pricing hikes. BOE forced to tighten into slowing economy. UK-specific debt premium widening vs US/Germany.

us_cycle.name: US Cycle Position
us_cycle.note: ESCALATED 16:00 UTC: Fed held rates in July but multiple members voted to hike. 30Y Treasury at 5.34% (19yr high) is itself a tightening mechanism. September hike now in play. Global bond sell-off pressuring all sovereign yields.

middle_east.name: Middle East Tension
middle_east.description: Brent Oil as ME tension proxy (Yahoo BZ=F)
middle_east.note: ESCALATED 16:00 UTC: Trump declares Hormuz 'US territory' after 60-day deal deadline expired. No talks planned with Iran. Hormuz remains closed. US naval blockade ongoing. Iran says Israel is biggest obstacle to negotiations.
